known_source_discrepancies.note: Slide heading 'more than one change in sign will lead to multiple IRRs' overstates; correct possibility is multiple or no real IRRs, as slide 31 also says.
Graph labels 15.6% for red G and 33.3% for F, inconsistent with slide 23 reporting G≈20% and incremental G−F≈15.6%; preserve slide markings and table separately.
Slide's blanket 'all funds reinvested at IRR' is an interpretive claim, not a mathematical requirement for calculating IRR.
Highest weighted average PI only under additional assumptions; multi-period/indivisible allocations require optimization.
